name: Learn-Forge SaaS Platform
desc: A production-ready e-learning SaaS platform built with Vue.js and FastAPI. Delivers course management, student progress tracking, interactive quizzes, subscription billing, and a powerful admin dashboard — all backed by a scalable PostgreSQL database with full REST API architecture.

name: Grains & Grounds
desc: A designer-focused web interface for a specialty coffee brand. Built with semantic HTML5 and vanilla CSS, it features a clean responsive layout, dynamic tabbed menus, and smooth scroll animations for a premium digital storefront and seamless user navigation.

name: Amber perfume web
desc: A minimalist, high-performance luxury e-commerce web application with dynamic fragrance family filtering, visual scent breakdown guides, interactive shopping cart capabilities, and smooth UI animations — built using vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

name: RestaurantHub Admin Dashboard
desc: A real-time restaurant operations dashboard built with Vue.js and FastAPI. Covers table reservations, live kitchen order tracking, digital menu management, staff scheduling, and revenue analytics charts — all powered by a PostgreSQL database with live WebSocket updates for front-of-house efficiency.

name: LandingPro Builder
desc: A pixel-perfect marketing landing page template system with a visual section builder, smooth GSAP scroll animations, mobile-first responsive layouts, and ready-to-deploy form integrations. Designed to help businesses launch high-converting product pages in hours, not weeks.

name: FileSync Desktop Tool
desc: A cross-platform desktop file sync and backup utility built with Python. Supports configurable sync schedules, AES-encrypted uploads to AWS S3, conflict resolution, and PostgreSQL-based sync history logging — giving teams a reliable, auditable backup workflow without complex infrastructure.
